title: Session Cookie
body:
A [[Cookies|cookie]] with no `Expires` or `Max-Age` attribute. The browser holds it only for the current browsing session and deletes it when the browser closes — session cookies and expired cookies are purged from the [[Cookie Jar]] on restart.

This is the usual choice for a login session: closing the browser ends the session, and nothing identifying is left on disk afterwards. The lifetime is enforced entirely by the browser, not the server.

Note that "session cookie" and `sessionStorage` are unrelated despite the name. A session cookie is attached automatically to every matching request and is shared across all tabs; [[sessionStorage]] is never sent anywhere and is scoped to one tab. Contrast with a [[Persistent Cookie]].
